title: Chemistry Retention, Curing, and Microbial Risk Workbook
purpose: Track volatile and cannabinoid stability, curing definitions, container equilibration, and microbial-risk controls across postharvest handling.

sections.title: Volatile Retention Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Does the comparison measure actual volatile retention rather than concentration changes caused only by water loss?

sections.title: Cannabinoid Stability Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Are apparent potency changes explained by chemistry, moisture basis, or both?

sections.title: Operational Curing Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Is curing defined by measurable conditions and acceptance criteria rather than an undefined waiting period?

sections.title: Container Moisture Redistribution Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Is moisture distribution becoming more uniform without creating localized high-aW risk?

sections.title: Drying/Curing Microbial Risk Record
sections.decisionPrompt: Does the evidence justify release, continued hold, investigation, or rejection?

qualityRules: Keep analytical method and sample basis constant across comparisons.
Do not equate concentration increase with chemical creation.
Define curing operationally before evaluating it.
Use qualified testing and hold controls when microbial risk is plausible.
